rationale: puppeteer-extra is a mature modular plugin framework for Puppeteer (and Playwright via playwright-extra) with a dedicated stealth plugin that implements 16 evasion techniques covering navigator.webdriver, chrome.runtime, user-agent/platform spoofing, navigator.plugins/mimeTypes, webgl.vendor, iframe.contentWindow, and more. The stealth plugin passes public bot detection tests (bot.sannysoft.com, fpscanner, headless-cat-n-mouse). Architecture includes a clean plugin base class with lifecycle hooks (beforeLaunch, onPageCreated, onTargetCreated, etc.), dependency resolution, and a utility library for stealthy DOM manipulation via JS Proxies with error-stack sanitization. The extract-stealth-evasions package allows bundling evasions for CDP-only use. Proxy-router plugin adds dynamic proxy routing. Tier A due to strong relevance to stealth pipeline concern, proven test results against detection, modular architecture, and dual Puppeteer/Playwright support.
limitations: Last significant commits appear to be from 2023; maintenance status uncertain
Some evasions require headful mode (user-preferences plugin)
No formal architecture documentation beyond README-generated API docs
Stealth is a plugin wrapper; core evasions are separate modules that could be used independently
Relies on Puppeteer/Playwright as peer dependencies; not a standalone browser automation engine
